ana: Quick check-in: we need to finalize the observability launch scope this sprint. Key customer asks: per-route cost, light trace hooks, and better error grouping. Who takes what?

mike: I9ll draft a minimal tracing SDK: events request_start/request_end, trace_id, sample flag. metadata-only unless sampled.

ruchi: I9ll own cost surfaces. MVP = aggregated per-route & per-model over 7d + live 1h. CSV export for finance.

sam: Dashboard owner. Propose three panels: latency (p50/p95), cost by route, error groups with sample traces. Drilldowns 1h/24h/7d.

nate: Error grouping: group by signature + prompt fingerprint; add regression alert. Need retention + cardinality limits.

ana: Privacy reminder: do NOT persist raw prompts by default. Sampled prompts must be redacted and opt-in.

mike: SDK emits route_id, model, token_count, trace_id by default. full prompt only when sample=true and consented.

ana: Launch acceptance (brief): aggregated dashboards (top-5 routes), SDK + server shim + examples (py/ts), cost CSV, error grouping + up to 3 sample traces, regression alert >50% relative increase, privacy default redact.

ruchi: Storage plan: pre-aggregate 1h buckets for 7d. Data task to implement rollups.

nate: Agreed schema: timestamp, route_id, model, token_sum, cost_estimate, error_count, latency_p50, latency_p95.

mike: Example payload: {"route_id":"r","model":"gpt-x","token_count":42,"trace_id":"uuid","event":"request_start"}.

ana: Rollout: hosted default sampling 0.1%, workspace opt-in to increase, Dedicated may enable fully. Beta goal: feature-flagged in 3 sprints, GA in 8.

owners: ruchi (cost, OBS-241), mike (SDK, OBS-242), sam (UX, OBS-243), nate (rollups/alerts, OBS-244), ana (acceptance/gating, OBS-245).

ops-bot: Add deploy checklist to OBS-245 before QA signoff.

ana: Thanks. Wireframes and acceptance doc incoming, triage tomorrow 9:30am PT.
